You'll Fall in Love With This Dream Home #luxurylisting 

A Rare Blend of Privacy, Water Access & Refined Design — Belton, TX

Escape to 12641 FM 93 — a custom estate where upscale interiors meet peaceful country surroundings. Nearly 3,000 sq ft of beautifully updated living space, plus a canning kitchen, a 360° “Treehouse” loft, a spacious workshop, and your own private stretch of Nolan Creek.

Just minutes from Fort Cavazos and Belton, this home delivers quiet, acreage living — without sacrificing access to town.

📞 Tours available by appointment
